boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: Giant worms tear open huge passageways through the deserts in the west. It is said great riches lie buried beneath the sand, still decorating the corpses of those who went there seeking great riches.
entries.target: 西部沙漠中的巨型蠕虫挖掘出了很多巨大的通道。传说在那沙洞深处埋藏着很多诱人的宝物。不过除了宝物之外，更多的便是那些寻宝人的尸体。

entries.source:
These opalescent orbs stare at you with deathly knowledge, undeceived by your vanities and pretences.  They have lived and died through horrors you could never imagine, and now they lie strung in black chords watching every twitch of the shadows.
If you close your eyes a moment, you can almost imagine what dread sights they see...
entries.target:
这些泛着乳白色光芒的眼球用死亡般的知识凝视着你，你的虚荣和伪装欺骗不了它们。它们曾在你无法想象的恐惧中生生死死，如今被黑色丝线串起，注视着阴影的每一下颤动。
如果你闭上眼睛片刻，几乎能想象出它们所见过的恐怖景象……

entries.source: The target's strength is increased by %d by the thrill of combat.
entries.target: 由于紧张的战斗，目标力量属性增加 %d。

entries.source: Saw a huge meteor falling from the sky.
entries.target: 看到一块巨大的陨石从天而降。

entries.source: A strange growth on the dungeon floor.
10% chance to shimmer to a different hue and gain powers
entries.target: 10% 几率变换不同颜色并且增加强度

entries.source: #CRIMSON##Target# is torn open by the powerful blow!

You enter into a fighting trance, gaining 15%% resist all, losing 15 mindpower, but gaining 20 mental save. However, each turn after the fifth that this talent is active, there is a chance that you will be overcome and become confused.
This does not take a turn to use.
entries.target:
你进入战斗狂热状态，获得 15%% 全体伤害抗性，精神强度降低 15 点，但精神豁免提高 20 点。然而，从技能生效后的第 6 回合起，你每回合都有一定几率被压倒而陷入混乱。
使用此技能不消耗回合。

entries.source: Ever burning, ever dying, ever reviving, the Phoenix swoops down upon you, seeking to share its fiery fate with you.
entries.target: 燃烧，死亡，重生。这只不死鸟试图将它燃烧的命运带给你。

entries.source:
You have trained to be very light on your feet and have conditioned your reflexes to react faster than thought to damage you take.
		While this talent is active, you instantly react to any direct damage (not from status effects, etc.) that would hit you for at least %d%% of your maximum life.
		This requires %0.1f stamina and reduces the damage by %d%%.
		Your reactions are too slow for this if you are wearing heavy armour.
		The damage reduction improves with your Defense.
entries.target:
经过训练后，你脚步轻快，神经敏锐。
		技能开启时，你会对超过你 %d%% 最大生命值的直接伤害做出反应（状态效果带来的伤害除外）。
		消耗 %0.1f 体力，你将减少 %d%% 伤害。
		身着重甲时无法使用。
		伤害减免受闪避加成。

entries.source: The target is off balance and is %d%% more likely to be crit by the target that set it up.  In addition all its saves are reduced by %d.
entries.target: 目标失去平衡，被设局者暴击的概率提高 %d%%，另外所有豁免值下降 %d。

entries.source: Only the most powerful spellcasters raised to unlife become liches. Doomed to haunt the world for an eternity, they have grown to hate all that breathes or trespasses on their domain. Unfortunately that includes you.
entries.target: 只有最强大的法师，才会被复活成为巫妖。他们注定要永远萦绕在这个世界上，他们憎恨所有在他们的领地上呼吸或侵入的人。不幸的是，这包括你在内。

entries.source: This ordinary blade is made of fine, sturdy voratun and outfitted with jagged hooks along the edge. This simple appearance belies a great power - the hooked maw of this dagger broke many a blade and the stride of many would-be warriors.
entries.target: 这柄普通的匕首是由精制坚硬的沃瑞钽制成的，配有锯齿钩边。看似平凡的外表背后潜藏着强大的力量——它破坏过诸多刀刃，收割走那些战士的生命和未来。

entries.source: To complete your resurrection you must kill a unique/boss/elite boss rank creature before the duration expires.
entries.target: 为了完成你的复活，你必须在持续时间结束前，杀死一个 史诗/Boss/精英Boss 等级的敌人。

entries.source: Wait here while I perform my art. I'll have your reward within the hour.
entries.target: 在这儿等着，容我施展技艺。一小时内我就会备好你的报酬。

entries.source: You have intruded on their ground, and they will defend it at all costs.
entries.target: 你已经闯入了它们的地盘，它们会不择手段的攻击你。

entries.source: #PURPLE#As the orc greatmother falls you realize you have dealt a crippling blow to the orcs.
entries.target: #PURPLE#当兽人母体倒下时你意识到你对兽人部落造成了致命的打击。

entries.source: The energy is too low. It needs to be at least 25.
entries.target: 能量过低，至少需要25点能量。

entries.source: Have you heard, the old forest seems to have been claimed by a new evil!
entries.target: 你有听说过吗，有人说在古老森林出现了新的怪物！

entries.source: You saved %s of us, please take this as a reward. (They give you %s)
entries.target: 你救下了我们中的%s人，请你收下这个作为奖励吧。(他们给了你 %s)

entries.source: The eerie night around #target# fades away.

Touch your foe and turn it to stone for %d turns.
		Stoned creatures are unable to act or regen life, and are very brittle.
		If a stoned creature is hit by an attack that deals more than 30%% of its life, it will shatter and be destroyed.
		Stoned creatures are highly resistant to fire and lightning, and somewhat resistant to physical attacks.
		At level 3 the touch will become a beam.
		This spell may fail against creatures resistant to being stunned, that are specifically immune to stoning, or certain bosses.
entries.target:
触碰敌人，将其石化 %d 回合。
		石化的生物无法行动或恢复生命，且非常脆弱。
		如果石化生物受到一次超过其 30%% 生命值的攻击，它会碎裂并被摧毁。
		石化生物对火焰和闪电伤害具有极高抗性，对物理伤害也有一定抗性。
		技能等级 3 时，此触碰变为一束射线。
		此法术可能对抵抗震慑、特别免疫石化的生物或某些首领失效。

entries.source:
#GOLD#Mental speed#LAST#
Mental speed represents how fast you use psionic abilities compared to normal.
Higher is faster.
entries.target:
#GOLD#精神速度#LAST#
精神速度是你使用灵能技能的速度。
值越高速度越快。

entries.source: The ravages of the Spellblaze stretched armies thin and left many unprotected. Not everyone could afford the luxury of a weapon.
entries.target: 魔法大爆炸的肆虐让军队捉襟见肘，许多人失去了保护。不是每个人都买得起武器这样的奢侈品。

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You notice an entrance to an underwater cave.
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你发现了一个水下洞穴的入口。

entries.source: A vial of murky white fluid.
A pair of boots made of leather.
Ah yes, my men have found that in Grushnak Pride. Here:
entries.target: 啊，是的，我们的人在格鲁希纳克部落找到了这个水晶球。给你：

entries.source: It desires to be surrounded by undeath.
Increases weapon damage by %d%% and physical power by 30 when using daggers.
entries.target: 使用匕首时，增加 %d%% 伤害，增加 30 物理强度。
回复 %d%% 持续 %d 回合 ; %d 法力瞬回；冷却 %d

entries.source:
So, you tasted blood? Liked it? I am sure you did; you are just that kind of people.
Anyway, I suppose you deserve your reward.
You can always participate again for fun, if you've got the gold to spare.
entries.target:
那么，你尝到鲜血的滋味了？喜欢吗？我敢说你一定喜欢；你就是那种人。
总之，我想你配得上这份奖赏。
只要你还有闲钱，随时可以再来参加，找点乐子。

entries.source:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#The creature glares at you.#WHITE#*
You are the master. You can use this place as you desire. However, most of the energies are depleted and only some rooms are usable.
To the south you will find the storage room.
entries.target:
*#LIGHT_GREEN#那个生物瞪着你。#WHITE#*
你是主人，可以随意使用这里。不过，这里的能量大多已经耗尽，只有少数房间还能使用。
南面是储藏室。
